reels.caption:
😍Morocco like Pinterest: the most beautiful hotels 🇲🇦

📍 Royal Mansour Marrakech
One of the most luxurious hotels in the world, where every guest stays in a private riad with its own courtyard and pool. Carved ceilings, mosaics, and palm gardens. Breakfasts on the terrace and a spa under a glass dome.

📍 El Fenn
A place where Morocco meets contemporary art. Bright walls, terracotta rooftop pools, vintage furniture, and rich colors. A bohemian vibe with sunsets overlooking the medina.

📍 La Mamounia
A true Marrakech legend. Expansive gardens, arched galleries, emerald tiles, and a pool you'll want to spend all day in. Classic luxury with history.

📍 Riad Yasmine
The iconic Instagram riad with an emerald pool and pink walls. Small, cozy, and incredibly photogenic. Breakfast by the pool with flower petals.

📍 Amanjena
Minimalism with Moroccan architecture. Sandy tones, reflective pools, and perfect symmetry.

📍 Kasbah Tamadot
A hotel in the Atlas Mountains with views over the valleys. Terraces, Berber style, and warm sunset light.

📍 The Oberoi Marrakech
Modern luxury with an oriental touch. Grand pools, arches, reflective water, and clean geometry.

📍 Scarabeo Camp
White tents in the Agafay desert. Minimalism, sand dunes, camels, and caramel-colored sunsets.
